summary: V4-09 repair candidate accepted. Trusted verification passed (exit 0). The delta repairs the concrete infrastructure blocker that caused trusted finalizer runs 37909577314 and 37976784854 to abort before the wrapper started: the emulator-runner action's built-in `input keyevent 82` hit a broken pipe on the unaccelerated API 35 x86_64 runner. The repair introduces a self-contained emulator boot script (scripts/boot-emulator.sh) with a live input/settings round-trip gate, and enhances scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh with emulator ownership fallback and the same live probe. Product/privacy/cost/i18n gates remain green; no V4-01..V4-08 regression; no forbidden labels introduced; all 661 tests pass.

findings.problem: New self-contained emulator boot script; installs SDK packages and creates AVD on every invocation when no device attached.
findings.evidence: Script lines 91-109 install platform-tools, emulator, platform, system image and create AVD unconditionally. This is acceptable for the fallback path (no device attached) and matches the emulator-runner defaults (API 35, x86_64, pixel_6, 2 CPU cores).
findings.requiredFix: None. The script is only invoked when adb get-state shows no device, which in the new strategy becomes the normal finalizer path. Idempotent SDK installs and AVD creation are standard CI practice.
findings.verification: bash -n passes; contract tests in v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts verify AVD creation, emulator flags, service checks, and live input probe.

findings.problem: Emulator ownership fallback changes the finalizer strategy from depending on reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 to owning the emulator lifecycle when run from a plain run: step.
findings.evidence: Lines 31-56: adb get-state check -> if no device, boot via scripts/boot-emulator.sh and export ANDROID_SERIAL. Lines 67-85: framework_cmd_ready() now probes both settings get AND input keyevent 0 (the exact service that failed). Lines 94-119: wait_android_services() requires package/activity/input/settings registration AND live round-trip.
findings.requiredFix: None. This is the documented strategy change per V4_RELEASE_ENGINEERING.md §7: 'une répétition identique sans nouvelle preuve doit changer de stratégie, pas seulement augmenter les timeouts'. The action-driven path is preserved when a device is already attached.
findings.verification: Contract tests verify the fallback logic, framework_cmd_ready probes, and boot-emulator.sh integration. Trusted verification exit 0 confirms no regression.

findings.evidence: Tests: 'framework_cmd_ready probes a live input round-trip', 'wrapper owns the emulator boot when no device is attached', 'scripts/boot-emulator.sh exists, parses, and gates on a live input probe'. All verify static contracts without emulator.
findings.requiredFix: None. Tests are pure contract guards; they run in plain CI and passed in trusted verification.
